faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our platform
faq.question1: How does the free trial work?
faq.answer1: Start with our Free Starter plan immediately. Upgrade to paid plans anytime with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
faq.question2: Can I accept payments in Ethiopian Birr?
faq.answer2: Yes! We support TeleBirr, Chapa, and M-PESA for local Ethiopian Birr payments, plus international options like Stripe and PayPal.
faq.question3: Do my customers need to download an app?
faq.answer3: No. Customers can book via your personalized booking link in any web browser, SMS, or USSD. No app download required.
faq.answer4: Customers text your booking number, and our system guides them through available slots and confirms their appointment automatically.
faq.answer5: Yes! Business and Enterprise plans support multiple locations with separate calendars, staff, and availability for each location.
faq.question6: Is my data secure and compliant with Ethiopian law?
faq.answer6: Absolutely. We comply with Ethiopia's Personal Data Protection Proclamation 1321/2024 with bank-grade encryption and secure data storage.
faq.question7: What happens if I exceed my plan limits?
faq.answer7: We'll notify you and help you upgrade. Your service continues uninterrupted, and you only pay for what you use.
faq.question8: Do you offer support in Amharic?
faq.answer8: Yes! Our platform and customer support are available in both English and Amharic.

analyticsDefinitions.meanDaysBetweenSuccessiveCompletedVisits: Mean days between successive completed visits for email identities selected in period. Observed history only.
analyticsDefinitions.meanDaysSinceLastCompletedVisit: Mean days since last completed visit, as of today. Email identities selected in period.
analyticsDefinitions.ruleNoCompletedVisitForAt: Rule: no completed visit for at least 90 days, among selected email identities with a completed visit. Not a prediction.
analyticsDefinitions.secondCompletedVisitWithin90Days: Second completed visit within 90 days / first observed permitted completed visit cohorts in period with a full 90-day observation window.
analyticsDefinitions.matureFirstObservedPermittedCompletedVis: Mature first observed permitted completed visit cohorts; count shown is 90-day retained customers. Data table declares eligible cohort size.
analyticsDefinitions.largestEmailIdentityBookingCountAll: Largest email identity booking count / all selected bookings with email.
analyticsDefinitions.phoneDigitGroupsAssociatedWithSeveral: Phone digit groups associated with several emails in selected records. Review candidates, not resolved identities.
analyticsDefinitions.selectedRecordsWithoutProvisionalEmailId: Selected records without provisional email identity.
analyticsDefinitions.largestEmailIdentityRecordedAmountAll: Largest email identity recorded amount / all positive recorded amounts. Not lifetime value or payment-date revenue.
analyticsDefinitions.recordedAmountOnSelectedBookingsEmail: Recorded amount on selected bookings / email identities. Missing entry cannot be distinguished from unpaid.
analyticsDefinitions.customersWithALaterCompletedVisit: Customers with a later completed visit within {0} days / first observed permitted completed visit cohort in period with full {0}-day observation. Ineligible immature cohorts excluded. Email identity.
analyticsDefinitions.emailIdentitiesWithAtLeastOne: Email identities with at least one {0} booking in period; separate outcomes.
analyticsDefinitions.latestCompletedStatusTodayInBusiness: Latest Completed status, today in business timezone, independent reporting range.
analyticsDefinitions.allBookingsTodayGroupedByProvider: All bookings today, grouped by provider, independent reporting range.
analyticsDefinitions.overlappingOccupiedIntervalsForTheSame: Overlapping occupied intervals for the same provider; unordered pairs counted once. All scoped history, current records only.
analyticsDefinitions.distinctActiveEligibleProvidersInYour: Distinct active eligible providers in your offering scope.
analyticsDefinitions.distinctActiveEligibleLocationsInYour: Distinct active eligible locations in your offering scope.
analyticsDefinitions.nextFuturePendingConfirmedAppointmentIn: Next future Pending/Confirmed appointment in your scope, independent reporting range.
analyticsDefinitions.providersUsingCustomHoursWithNo: Providers using custom hours with no configured opening-hour rows. Inherited hours are not missing.
analyticsDefinitions.currentLocationOpeningHourRowsMarked: Current location opening-hour rows marked open. Provider/service intersections and holidays are not represented here.
analyticsDefinitions.locationsWithCapturedOpenStateUnconfigur: Locations with captured Open state. Unconfigured locations are unknown, not closed.
analyticsDefinitions.meanCurrentWaitSinceCreationFor: Mean current wait since creation for waiting walk-ins, as of generated time.
analyticsDefinitions.meanCapturedAssignmentMinusWalkIn: Mean captured assignment minus walk-in creation, UTC. Historical missing assignments excluded. All scoped walk-ins.
analyticsDefinitions.assignedWalkInsAllScopedWalk: Assigned walk-ins / all scoped walk-ins, latest state.
analyticsDefinitions.servicesMissingAPositiveDurationOr: Services missing a positive duration or a price field. Zero is a valid free price.
analyticsDefinitions.presentSetupCategoriesServicesEligibleOf: Present setup categories: services, eligible offerings, active scoped locations. Three checks, not a website readiness verdict.
analyticsDefinitions.installedWorkbookImportsRecordSuccessful: Installed workbook imports record successful committed results only. Pending/error lifecycle is not stored; no inferred zero.
analyticsDefinitions.currentInvitationStatesForThisBusiness: Current invitation states for this business, all time.
analyticsDefinitions.publishingRejectsFailedWritesAtomicallyN: Publishing rejects failed writes atomically. No business-scoped persistent error lifecycle is installed; absence is not zero.
analyticsDefinitions.workbookImportStoresCommittedSuccessfulS: Workbook import stores committed successful summaries, not failed/pending attempts. Error coverage unavailable.
analyticsDefinitions.meanAcceptedInvitationTimestampMinusCrea: Mean accepted invitation timestamp minus creation. Unaccepted invitations excluded, all time.
analyticsDefinitions.immutableContentReleaseStatesGroupedBy: Immutable content release states grouped by recorded type. Historical versions included, not unique live articles.
analyticsDefinitions.immutableContentReleasesWithExplicitPubl: Immutable content releases with explicit published_at; all time. Retries reuse release contracts. No modified-time inference.
analyticsDefinitions.contentReleaseWithdrawalsWithExplicitWit: Content release withdrawals with explicit withdrawn_at, all time.
analyticsDefinitions.oneIfThePublicSiteLatest: One if the Public Site latest state is Published; zero if present and unpublished.
analyticsDefinitions.collectionsMissingCoverItemsOrAwaiting: Collections missing cover/items or awaiting consent review. A review checklist, not publish-readiness certification.
analyticsDefinitions.campaignLatestStatusErrorPrivateError: Campaign latest status Error. Private error text is excluded.
analyticsDefinitions.senderIdentitiesWithVerifiedStateNo: Sender identities with Verified state. No external delivery claim.
analyticsDefinitions.audienceWithCapturedConfirmationAllAudie: Audience with captured confirmation / all audience records. All time, business scope.
analyticsDefinitions.meanAudienceConfirmationMinusConsentTime: Mean audience confirmation minus consent timestamp, stored system timezone, all time.
analyticsDefinitions.audienceWithACapturedUnsubscribeTimestam: Audience with a captured unsubscribe timestamp, all time. No delivery/engagement inference.
analyticsDefinitions.latestCampaignStateScheduledScheduledTim: Latest campaign state Scheduled; scheduled timestamp is not evidence of delivery.
analyticsDefinitions.allScopedWalkInRecordsIn: All scoped walk-in records in latest {0} state; independent reporting range.
analyticsDefinitions.current0StatesInThisBusiness: Current {0} states in this business. Not website visits, real inbox delivery or engagement.
analyticsDefinitions.localCampaign0CounterDoesNot: Local campaign {0} counter; does not prove inbox delivery (LF-16).
analyticsDefinitions.audience0DatesInStoredSystem: Audience {0} dates in stored system timezone, all time. No modified-time or website tracking inference.
analyticsDefinitions.unionOfCurrentEligibleWorkingWindows: Union of current eligible working windows by provider. Historical denominator is a current-schedule estimate (LF-09).
analyticsDefinitions.currentWorkingWindowsMinusRecordedOccupi: Current working windows minus recorded occupied intervals. Calendar blocks are not subtracted; future bookable slots use canonical conflicts.
analyticsDefinitions.contiguousUnoccupiedPartsOfCurrentWorkin: Contiguous unoccupied parts of current working windows. Includes opening/closing edges. Calendar blocks excluded.
analyticsDefinitions.currentScheduleGapsShorterThan30: Current schedule gaps shorter than 30 minutes. Fixed review rule, not evidence a service fits.
analyticsDefinitions.recordedOccupiedHoursInsideCurrentWorkin: Recorded occupied hours inside current working windows / available current working hours. Outside-window time excluded. LF-09 historical limitation.
analyticsDefinitions.providerDaysWithoutAnEligibleCurrent: Provider-days without an eligible current working window among active scoped offerings.
analyticsDefinitions.recordedOccupiedUnionMinusScheduledUnion: Recorded occupied union minus scheduled union / occupied union, by provider. Missing historical intervals excluded.
analyticsDefinitions.occupiedProviderIntervalUnionCurrentElig: Occupied provider interval union / current eligible working windows within each category. Category schedules can overlap; rates are not additive. Historical snapshots unavailable (LF-09).
analyticsDefinitions.requiresAppointmentDateScopeAndCurrent: Requires appointment-date scope and current schedules. Historical snapshots unavailable (LF-09).
analyticsDefinitions.capturedCancellationRescheduleActionsOnS: Captured cancellation/reschedule actions on selected bookings in the event window. Actor categories only.
analyticsDefinitions.meanCommittedOutcomeEventMinusScheduled: Mean committed outcome event minus scheduled end for overdue selected bookings, in event window. Each committed resolution counts. Availability/setup issue resolution is not implied.
analyticsDefinitions.selectedCapturedCancellationsWithAnExpli: Selected captured cancellations with an explicit replacement link in the event window / selected captured cancellations. No inferred overlap recovery.
analyticsDefinitions.selectedPendingConfirmedAppointmentsBySc: Selected Pending/Confirmed appointments by scheduled business weekday; counts, not occupied hours.
analyticsDefinitions.meanCapturedArrivalMinusScheduledUtc: Mean captured arrival minus scheduled UTC start. Negative means early.
analyticsDefinitions.meanActualServiceDurationMinusScheduled: Mean actual service duration minus scheduled duration. Negative means shorter.
analyticsDefinitions.meanCapturedServiceStartMinusCheck: Mean captured service start minus check-in. Appointment reception wait, separate from walk-in assignment wait.
analyticsDefinitions.durationService: Mean scheduled duration by service for all selected latest states. Category averages are not additive.
analyticsDefinitions.capturedService: Mean captured {0} minus {1} by service. Missing timestamps excluded.
analyticsDefinitions.preferenceService: Most frequently selected service per provisional email identity. Ties count each choice.
analyticsDefinitions.durationProvider: Mean scheduled duration by provider for all selected latest states. Category averages are not additive.
analyticsDefinitions.capturedProvider: Mean captured {0} minus {1} by provider. Missing timestamps excluded.
analyticsDefinitions.preferenceProvider: Most frequently selected provider per provisional email identity. Ties count each choice.
analyticsDefinitions.durationLocation: Mean scheduled duration by location for all selected latest states. Category averages are not additive.
analyticsDefinitions.capturedLocation: Mean captured {0} minus {1} by location. Missing timestamps excluded.
analyticsDefinitions.preferenceLocation: Most frequently selected location per provisional email identity. Ties count each choice.
